title: Discover all inventory kinds and preserve their selected revision context
preconditions: Disposable format-2 Saga with one System, Component and data entity in each of these states: code-free proposed; implemented with exact current evidence; legacy unspecified; historical selected pin; conflicting heads. Give each a distinct description, known stable identity and declared feature Item use. Retain named comparison baseline/head and a second unrelated feature.

steps.action: Query public inventory for each kind and page both records and unresolved records to completion. Compare each row to the authored fixture.
steps.expected_result: Each resolvable row exposes exact identity, description, selected revision intent and code health; unspecified is not inferred as proposed or implemented; historical/conflicted records remain identified.

steps.action: Apply proposed and new filters independently and together, restrict by the fixture feature, and inspect declared scope_paths and comparison fields. Repeat without a comparison.
steps.expected_result: All three explicitly proposed kinds are returned with their selected states, unrelated proposals are excluded, implemented-new identities remain new, baseline/head are named, and baseline-free results invent no newness.

steps.action: From System membership and data-entity holder/relationship pins follow exact definitions, code references and inventory-uses to feature/deck/slide/Item.
steps.expected_result: Each declared hop resolves the recorded revision and source commit/path/range; reverse usage names every originating context without inventing missing links.

steps.action: For each implemented kind, publish a proposed successor under its existing stable identity using the implemented revision as baseline; pin baseline through its exact committed view and successor from a new design.
steps.expected_result: Both baseline and proposed successor remain readable under one identity and deck references distinguish their exact revisions.
